title: Open localized finite pullback is the pulled-back extension counit
statement:
Let $g:T'\to T$ be a scheme morphism, $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion and $j':U'=T'\times_TU\hookrightarrow T'$ its inverse image, with $g_U:U'\to U$. Work on small pro-etale sites and their slice identifications [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Let $B$ be a finite commutative ring and use its canonical coefficient maps [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] and module tensor pullbacks [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $g_B^*$ for this pullback, $j^*,j'^*$ for restriction, and $j_!F=P_F^\#$ for the extension of [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], with its adjunction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] and the unit-compatible slice sheafification comparison [lem-cbc-sieve-slice-sheafification]. Define $H=j'^*g_B^*j_!$. If $\epsilon:j_!j^*\to\mathrm{id}$ is the actual adjunction counit, then
$$\beta=j'^*g_B^*(\epsilon):Hj^*\longrightarrow j'^*g_B^*$$
is an isomorphism. Under the canonical identification $H\cong g_{U,B}^*$ from [lem-weil-pbc-localize-ringed-site-morphism], $\beta$ is exactly the canonical localized pullback comparison $g_{U,B}^*j^*\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^*g_B^*$. Its generator formula evaluates the summand indexed by $V\to U$ as the same section on $V$. For the actual adjunction $j_!\dashv j^*$, the unit sends a section $s\in F(V\to U)$ to its generator in the summand indexed by $V\to U$, followed by sheafification. The counit $j_!j^*M\to M$ sends the generator in each such summand to the same section of $M(V)$.

proof.text: Work directly in the published AsSmall pro-etale models and their literal Over categories. The base-change functor preserves finite limits because its three factors do; its continuity is already published. Apply the canonical module inverse-mate isomorphism to the actual constant-section coefficient map, obtaining invertibility of lambda = cbcOpenSliceComparison. No change of coefficient maps or of slice coordinates is required.

The existsUnique specification of localizedSystemAdjunction gives the actual unit formula: include a section into its structure-arrow summand, then apply the module sheafification unit. Apply the right adjunction triangle on a slice object to obtain the counit formula on that same sheafified generator. This uses the given normalized adjunction and does not choose a replacement adjunction.

Since U.hom is an open immersion it is mono. Equality after composition with U.hom shows that every object of the pro-etale model has at most one arrow to U. On a slice object the direct-sum injection into the structure-arrow summand is therefore an isomorphism, whose inverse is the component projection. These give a natural isomorphism from F to the restriction of its extension presheaf, checked on each summand. The restricted presheaf is consequently a sheaf. The unit-compatible sheafification comparison along Over.forget identifies the restricted global sheafification unit with the local sheafification unit followed by an isomorphism. Both are invertible, and the formula of the preceding step identifies their composite with the underlying normalized extension unit. Forgetting module structure reflects isomorphisms, so this actual unit is invertible.

Define alpha by the inverse of lambda whiskered by extension, followed by localized pullback of the inverse extension unit (with associators and unitors). Its inverse has the prescribed formula by functoriality. To prove beta = alpha followed by lambda, precompose with alpha inverse, use naturality of lambda at the actual extension counit, combine the two pullback maps, and apply the right adjunction triangle. Hence beta is invertible componentwise.

For any sheaf-module map f, linearity of pullback(f), naturality along psi, and naturality of the pullback-adjunction unit show that pullback(f) sends the generator indexed by (V,psi,s,b) to the generator indexed by (V,psi,f(s),b). Apply this to the actual extension counit and use its summand evaluation formula from the right triangle. This proves the requested inverse-image/tensor generator formula without any assertion that all global sheaf sections are generators.

The abelian slice-sheafification leaf with unit compatibility then makes eta_F an isomorphism; this is 0F6Z.
